1.web: For Yahweh will have compassion on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land. The foreigner will join himself with them, and they will unite with the house of Jacob.
1.asv: For Jehovah will have compassion on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land: and the sojourner shall join himself with them, and they shall cleave to the house of Jacob.

2.web: The peoples will take them, and bring them to their place. The house of Israel will possess them in Yahweh’s land for servants and for handmaids. They will take as captives those whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors.
2.asv: And the peoples shall take them, and bring them to their place; and the house of Israel shall possess them in the land of Jehovah for servants and for handmaids: and they shall take them captive whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors.

3.web: It will happen in the day that Yahweh will give you rest from your sorrow, from your trouble, and from the hard service in which you were made to serve,
3.asv: And it shall come to pass in the day that Jehovah shall give thee rest from thy sorrow, and from thy trouble, and from the hard service wherein thou wast made to serve,

4.web: that you will take up this parable against the king of Babylon, and say, “How the oppressor has ceased! The golden city has ceased!”
4.asv: that thou shalt take up this parable against the king of Babylon, and say, How hath the oppressor ceased! the golden city ceased!

5.web: Yahweh has broken the staff of the wicked, the scepter of the rulers,
5.asv: Jehovah hath broken the staff of the wicked, the sceptre of the rulers;

6.web: who struck the peoples in wrath with a continual stroke, who ruled the nations in anger, with a persecution that no one restrained.
6.asv: that smote the peoples in wrath with a continual stroke, that ruled the nations in anger, with a persecution that none restrained.

7.web: The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet. They break out song.
7.asv: The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet: they break forth into singing.

8.web: Yes, the fir trees rejoice with you, with the cedars of Lebanon, saying, “Since you are humbled, no lumberjack has come up against us.”
8.asv: Yea, the fir-trees rejoice at thee, and the cedars of Lebanon, saying, Since thou art laid low, no hewer is come up against us.

9.web: Sheol from beneath has moved for you to meet you at your coming. It stirs up the departed spirits for you, even all the rulers of the earth. It has raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations.
9.asv: Sheol from beneath is moved for thee to meet thee at thy coming; it stirreth up the dead for thee, even all the chief ones of the earth; it hath raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations.

10.web: They all will answer and ask you, “Have you also become as weak as we are? Have you become like us?”
10.asv: All they shall answer and say unto thee, Art thou also become weak as we? art thou become like unto us?

11.web: Your pomp is brought down to Sheol, with the sound of your stringed instruments. Maggots are spread out under you, and worms cover you.
11.asv: Thy pomp is brought down to Sheol, and the noise of thy viols: the worm is spread under thee, and worms cover thee.

12.web: How you have fallen from heaven, morning star, son of the dawn! How you are cut down to the ground, who laid the nations low!
12.asv: How art thou fallen from heaven, O day-star, son of the morning! how art thou cut down to the ground, that didst lay low the nations!

13.web: You said in your heart, “I will ascend into heaven! I will exalt my throne above the stars of God! I will sit on the mountain of assembly, in the far north!
13.asv: And thou saidst in thy heart, I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of God; and I will sit upon the mount of congregation, in the uttermost parts of the north;

14.web: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds! I will make myself like the Most High!”
14.asv: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds; I will make myself like the Most High.

15.web: Yet you shall be brought down to Sheol, to the depths of the pit.
15.asv: Yet thou shalt be brought down to Sheol, to the uttermost parts of the pit.

16.web: Those who see you will stare at you. They will ponder you, saying, “Is this the man who made the earth to tremble, who shook kingdoms;
16.asv: They that see thee shall gaze at thee, they shall consider thee, saying, Is this the man that made the earth to tremble, that did shake kingdoms;

17.web: who made the world like a wilderness, and overthrew its cities; who didn’t release his prisoners to their home?”
17.asv: that made the world as a wilderness, and overthrew the cities thereof; that let not loose his prisoners to their home?

18.web: All the kings of the nations, sleep in glory, everyone in his own house.
18.asv: All the kings of the nations, all of them, sleep in glory, every one in his own house.

19.web: But you are cast away from your tomb like an abominable branch, clothed with the slain, who are thrust through with the sword, who go down to the stones of the pit; like a dead body trodden under foot.
19.asv: But thou art cast forth away from thy sepulchre like an abominable branch, clothed with the slain, that are thrust through with the sword, that go down to the stones of the pit; as a dead body trodden under foot.

20.web: You will not join them in burial, because you have destroyed your land. You have killed your people. The seed of evildoers will not be named forever.
20.asv: Thou shalt not be joined with them in burial, because thou hast destroyed thy land, thou hast slain thy people; the seed of evil-doers shall not be named for ever.

21.web: Prepare for slaughter of his children because of the iniquity of their fathers, that they not rise up and possess the earth, and fill the surface of the world with cities.
21.asv: Prepare ye slaughter for his children for the iniquity of their fathers, that they rise not up, and possess the earth, and fill the face of the world with cities.

22.web: “I will rise up against them,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and cut off from Babylon name and remnant, and son and son’s son,” says Yahweh.
22.asv: And I will rise up against them, saith Jehovah of hosts, and cut off from Babylon name and remnant, and son and son’s son, saith Jehovah.

23.web: “I will also make it a possession for the porcupine, and pools of water. I will sweep it with the broom of destruction,” says Yahweh of Armies.
23.asv: I will also make it a possession for the porcupine, and pools of water: and I will sweep it with the besom of destruction, saith Jehovah of hosts.

24.web: Yahweh of Armies has sworn, saying, “Surely, as I have thought, so shall it happen; and as I have purposed, so shall it stand:
24.asv: Jehovah of hosts hath sworn, saying, Surely, as I have thought, so shall it come to pass; and as I have purposed, so shall it stand:

25.web: that I will break the Assyrian in my land, and tread him under foot on my mountains. Then his yoke will leave them, and his burden leave their shoulders.
25.asv: that I will break the Assyrian in my land, and upon my mountains tread him under foot: then shall his yoke depart from off them, and his burden depart from off their shoulder.

26.web: This is the plan that is determined for the whole earth. This is the hand that is stretched out over all the nations.
26.asv: This is the purpose that is purposed upon the whole earth; and this is the hand that is stretched out upon all the nations.

27.web: For Yahweh of Armies has planned, and who can stop it? His hand is stretched out, and who can turn it back?”
27.asv: For Jehovah of hosts hath purposed, and who shall annul it? and his hand is stretched out, and who shall turn it back?

28.web: This burden was in the year that king Ahaz died.
28.asv: In the year that king Ahaz died was this burden.

29.web: Don’t rejoice, O Philistia, all of you, because the rod that struck you is broken; for out of the serpent’s root an adder will emerge, and his fruit will be a fiery flying serpent.
29.asv: Rejoice not, O Philistia, all of thee, because the rod that smote thee is broken; for out of the serpent’s root shall come forth an adder, and his fruit shall be a fiery flying serpent.

30.web: The firstborn of the poor will eat, and the needy will lie down in safety; and I will kill your root with famine, and your remnant will be killed.
30.asv: And the first-born of the poor shall feed, and the needy shall lie down in safety; and I will kill thy root with famine, and thy remnant shall be slain.

31.web: Howl, gate! Cry, city! You are melted away, Philistia, all of you; for smoke comes out of the north, and there is no straggler in his ranks.
31.asv: Howl, O gate; cry, O city; thou art melted away, O Philistia, all of thee; for there cometh a smoke out of the north, and there is no straggler in his ranks.

32.web: What will they answer the messengers of the nation? That Yahweh has founded Zion, and in her the afflicted of his people will take refuge.
32.asv: What then shall one answer the messengers of the nation? That Jehovah hath founded Zion, and in her shall the afflicted of his people take refuge.
